Classes of the errors and warnings of the censored statistics

Source: R/conditions.R
tobit_condition_classes.Rd

Every error and warning the package raises has a class from this table, so a caller can handle one without matching its message. The classes follow one pattern: tobit_mean_error_<what> for an error and tobit_mean_warning_<what> for a warning, and every error also has the class "tobit_mean_error" (every warning "tobit_mean_warning") before the classes stop() and warning() gave in 0.1.0: "simpleError", "error", and "condition" ("simpleWarning", "warning", and "condition"). The classes are added in front, and the messages and calls are unchanged from 0.1.0, so tryCatch(..., error = ), inherits(e, "simpleError"), and code that matches the message keep working. A printed condition shows its first class, so it begins with the new class name.

Usage

tobit_condition_classes

Format

A data.frame with one row per class: class, type ("error" or "warning"), message (the message, or NA for "tobit_mean_error_internal", whose message names the check that failed), and meaning

Classes

tobit_mean_error_mu_not_scalar

error: The mean given to a constructor such as as_mean_tobit() is not one value. ("'mu' must be a scalar")

tobit_mean_error_sd_not_scalar

error: The standard deviation given to a constructor such as as_mean_tobit() is not one value. ("'sd' must be a scalar")

tobit_mean_error_mu_not_numeric

error: The mean given to a constructor such as as_mean_tobit() is not a number. ("'mu' must be numeric")

tobit_mean_error_sd_not_numeric

error: The standard deviation given to a constructor such as as_mean_tobit() is not a number. ("'sd' must be numeric")

tobit_mean_error_sd_without_mu

error: A standard deviation was given with a missing mean. ("'sd' must be NA when 'mu' is NA")

tobit_mean_error_status_invalid

error: The status given to a constructor such as as_mean_tobit() is not one of tobit_status_codes. ("'status' must be NULL or one of tobit_status_codes$status")

tobit_mean_error_convert_not_na

error: A mean_tobit with a value was given to as_geomean_tobit(). ("mean_tobit can only be converted to a geomean_tobit if it is NA")

tobit_mean_error_x_is_mean_tobit

error: A result of the package was given as the values. ("'x' may not have class 'mean_tobit'")

tobit_mean_error_lower_not_numeric

error: The lower limit is not numeric. ("lower must be a numeric")

tobit_mean_error_lower_missing

error: The lower limit has a missing value. ("lower may not have missing values")

tobit_mean_error_lower_length

error: The lower limit is neither one value nor one per value. ("lower must be a scalar or the same length as x")

tobit_mean_error_upper_not_numeric

error: The upper limit is not numeric. ("upper must be a numeric")

tobit_mean_error_upper_missing

error: The upper limit has a missing value. ("upper may not have missing values")

tobit_mean_error_upper_length

error: The upper limit is neither one value nor one per value. ("upper must be a scalar or the same length as x")

tobit_mean_error_limits_not_ordered

error: A lower limit is not below its upper limit. ("each lower must be less than upper")

tobit_mean_error_x_not_finite

error: A value that is not censored, or a limit a censored value takes, is not finite. ("'x' must be finite unless it is censored at a finite limit")

tobit_mean_error_geomean_nonpositive

error: geomean_tobit() has a value and its lower limit both at or below zero. ("'x' and 'lower' cannot both be <= 0 at the same time")

tobit_mean_error_geomean_upper_nonpositive

error: geomean_tobit() has an upper limit at or below zero. ("some 'upper' values were at or below zero")

tobit_mean_error_internal

error: A check inside the package failed; its message names the check. Please report it as a bug.

tobit_mean_warning_sd_ignored

warning: A standard deviation was given to the conversion of a result, which keeps its own. ("'sd' is ignored for object conversion (sd is taken from the object)")

tobit_mean_warning_message_ignored

warning: A message was given to the conversion of a result, which keeps its own. ("'message' is ignored for object conversion (message is taken from the object)")

tobit_mean_warning_status_ignored

warning: A status was given to the conversion of a result, which keeps its own. ("'status' is ignored for object conversion (status is taken from the object)")

tobit_mean_warning_x_negative

warning: geomean_tobit() set values below zero to zero. ("some 'x' values were below zero, setting to zero")

tobit_mean_warning_lower_negative

warning: geomean_tobit() set lower limits below zero to zero. ("some 'lower' values were below zero, setting to zero")

See also

Other Censored Descriptive Statistics: geomean_tobit(), mean_tobit(), sd_tobit(), tobit_status_codes

  mean_tobit(1:3, lower = 2, upper = 2),
  tobit_mean_error_limits_not_ordered = function(e) conditionMessage(e)
)
#> [1] "each lower must be less than upper"
